headline: Upload + download latency histograms with Prometheus sidecar
summary: The daemon now records per-operation latency histograms for both uploads and downloads, and exposes them via an optional sidecar HTTP endpoint in Prometheus exposition format. Existing JSON-stats output from the `stats` CLI is unaffected.

items.title: Latency histograms for uploads + downloads
items.body: Both transfer paths now feed a fixed-bucket histogram so operators can scrape p50 / p95 / p99 from a single `stats` snapshot. Buckets follow Prometheus conventions and span sub-millisecond through tens-of-seconds latencies.

items.title: Optional Prometheus sidecar exposition endpoint
items.body: When enabled via config, the daemon binds an HTTP listener on a loopback-only port and serves `/metrics` in Prometheus exposition format. Disabled by default; bind address, port, and authentication mode are all configurable. The existing JSON-stats output via the `stats` CLI subcommand continues to work unchanged.
